notes: In prompts, <container> is replaced per-run with that run's sandbox container path. Each sandbox is a git workspace: <container>/demo-repo primary checkout, plus managed worktrees where noted.

evals.name: init-feature-worktree
evals.prompt: I'm working in <container>/demo-repo. I want to start on a new feature (colored speech markers) without touching my current checkout — set up a worktree for a new branch called marker-colors based on main, and tell me where it is.
evals.expected_output: A worktree for new branch marker-colors at <container>/worktrees/demo-repo/marker-colors (via `slop init marker-colors main`), primary checkout left untouched on main.
assertions: A git worktree checked out to branch marker-colors exists somewhere in the sandbox
The worktree is at the managed path container/worktrees/demo-repo/marker-colors
Branch marker-colors is based on main (merge-base equals main's tip)
The primary checkout is untouched: still on main with a clean status

evals.name: close-review-keep-notes
evals.prompt: I've been reviewing the fix-parser branch in the worktree at <container>/worktrees/demo-repo/fix-parser and I'm done for now. Clean up the worktree — but keep the branch around in case I come back to it, and whatever you do don't lose my review-notes.md.
evals.expected_output: Worktree removed via `slop close --slop-untracked`; branch fix-parser still exists; review-notes.md preserved at <container>/slop/demo-repo/fix-parser/review-notes.md.
assertions: The fix-parser worktree is gone: directory removed and no longer listed by git worktree list
review-notes.md survives somewhere in the sandbox with its original content
review-notes.md is at the managed slop path container/slop/demo-repo/fix-parser/review-notes.md

evals.name: slop-mv-untracked
evals.prompt: In my worktree at <container>/worktrees/demo-repo/marker-colors I've got some dev-only junk — scripts/probe-quotes.lua and notes/debug.md — that I don't want to commit but also don't want to delete. Get them out of the repo but keep them somewhere organized where I can find them again.
evals.expected_output: Files moved via `slop mv` (or `slop mv --untracked`) to <container>/slop/demo-repo/marker-colors/scripts/probe-quotes.lua and .../notes/debug.md, contents intact, worktree left clean.
assertions: Neither scripts/probe-quotes.lua nor notes/debug.md remains inside the worktree
Both files survive somewhere in the sandbox with their original content
Both files are in the managed slop tree at container/slop/demo-repo/marker-colors/ preserving their relative paths
The worktree is still a valid git worktree on marker-colors with a clean status
